title: Object-level authorization missing on invoice download
description: The invoice download handler uses a request-controlled invoice ID without checking that the invoice belongs to the authenticated user or tenant.
evidence: No tenant or owner check is visible before returning the PDF.

transformations: String parameter passed to repository lookup
sourceToSink.impact: Authenticated user can access another user's invoice by guessing or obtaining an ID

exploitability: An authenticated user can change the invoice ID in the URL and request invoices owned by other users if IDs are known or guessable.
attackScenario: A user downloads their invoice, changes the URL parameter to another invoice ID, and receives another customer's billing document.
impact: Unauthorized disclosure of billing data and potential cross-tenant data exposure.
remediation: Fetch invoices by both ID and authorized tenant/user, or enforce an authorization policy before returning the file.
